name: Reliability, Resilience & Fault Tolerance
description: Reliability, Resilience & Fault Tolerance standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-RES applies.

rules.title: Classify failure modes and define recovery behavior
rules.detail: For each critical dependency identify timeout, transient failure, permanent failure, partial response and unavailable behavior.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Classify failure modes and define recovery behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Classify failure modes and define recovery behavior.

rules.title: Use bounded timeouts and retries with backoff
rules.detail: Network and remote calls require timeouts; retry only retryable operations with capped attempts, jitter/backoff and idempotency awareness.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use bounded timeouts and retries with backoff.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use bounded timeouts and retries with backoff.

rules.title: Prevent cascading failures
rules.detail: Use bulkheads, circuit breakers, queue limits, load shedding or graceful degradation where dependency failure could exhaust shared resources.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prevent cascading failures.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prevent cascading failures.

rules.title: Design critical operations for idempotent recovery
rules.detail: Retries, duplicate delivery and process restart must not create duplicate business effects.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Design critical operations for idempotent recovery.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Design critical operations for idempotent recovery.

rules.title: Expose degraded state through observability and health
rules.detail: Operators must be able to distinguish healthy, degraded and failed dependencies and identify recovery progress.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Expose degraded state through observability and health.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Expose degraded state through observability and health.

rules.title: Validate resilience with controlled failure testing
rules.detail: Critical systems should exercise dependency loss, latency, restart and partial-failure scenarios in safe non-production or controlled environments.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Validate resilience with controlled failure testing.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Validate resilience with controlled failure testing.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-RES applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Reliability, Resilience & Fault Tolerance to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Reliability, Resilience & Fault Tolerance is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Reliability, Resilience & Fault Tolerance failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
